name: Chrome Hearts Black Leather Cargo Pants
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by Savonches. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Black cow leather cargo pants, straight fit. Pre-owned (dealer).
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters; under it a gothic "USA" between two small cross marks. Stitched all round.
Leather tab under the label: embossed, the number is not clearly legible in the photo.
Size tag: CHROME HEARTS scroll, "RN # 97729" at the fold, second scroll, "30", "170 / 84B".
Composition tag: "BODY: LEATHER: COW / LINING: 100% COTTON"; "CORPS: CUIR: VACHE / DOUBLURE: 100% COTON"; Japanese, Korean, Chinese; "MADE IN U.S.A.".

White printed care tag: five care symbols, "PROFESSIONAL LEATHER DRY CLEAN ONLY", "NETTOYAGE À SEC PROFESSIONNEL DU CUIR UNIQUEMENT", then Japanese, Korean and Chinese lines; CHROME HEARTS scroll sideways on the facing tag. "RN # 97729" printed on the edge.
